prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production 2D OVERWORLD ENVIRONMENT sprite sheet for an original JRPG inspired by Pokemon HeartGold Nintendo DS towns. Pure flat 2D top-down three-quarter view: north-facing roof visible and south/front facade visible, horizontal roof ridges and horizontal foundations, absolutely NO isometric diamond perspective, no 3D rendering, no realistic lighting, no painterly texture. Crisp low-resolution pixel clusters, dark colored outlines, 3-4 shades per material, cheerful sage/lime foliage, cream plaster and muted teal/coral roofs. Transparent background. Exactly SIX isolated game objects in an evenly spaced THREE-column TWO-row grid, square cells with generous empty margins, nothing overlapping cells. TOP ROW left: compact small house with dark teal tiled roof, cream walls, brown door and blue glass windows, NO garden. TOP ROW middle: second small house with coral-red roof, cream walls, blue glass, brown closed door, NO garden. TOP ROW right: one rounded leafy green tree with visible trunk, Pokemon DS style clustered canopy. BOTTOM ROW left: one short straight trimmed leafy hedge segment, horizontal, no flowers. BOTTOM ROW middle: one short pale stone boundary wall segment with two square end posts, horizontal. BOTTOM ROW right: one dark bronze street lamp with small warm cream glass box at top, a slim straight pole and small foot. All objects align to a square orthogonal map. Buildings should read cleanly at 64x48 game pixels, tree at 32x32, hedge/wall at 32x16, lamp at 16x32; emulate integer-upscaled pixels with few details. No characters, no text, no numbers, no labels, no grid lines. ABSOLUTELY NO FLOWERS, flowerpots, flower beds, planters, pink plants, garden beds anywhere. Keep complete objects fully visible.
